## Overview
Recommendation Sorting

## User Story
As a DevOps engineer, I want to sort recommendations by different criteria so that I can prioritize my work

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Add sorting options in filter bar
- [ ] Support sorting by time savings
- [ ] Enable sorting by difficulty level
- [ ] Allow sorting by implementation time
- [ ] Persist sort selection

## User Stories

### Add Sorting Controls UI
- **Story:** As a DevOps engineer, I want to see sorting options in the filter bar so that I can choose how to sort recommendations
- **Priority:** P2
- **Story Points:** 3
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Add sort dropdown to filter bar component
  - [ ] Include options for time savings, difficulty, and implementation time
  - [ ] Show currently selected sort option
  - [ ] Apply visual styling consistent with existing filter controls
  - [ ] Ensure dropdown is keyboard accessible

### Implement Recommendation Sort Service
- **Story:** As a DevOps engineer, I want recommendations to be sorted by my selected criteria so that I can view them in my preferred order
- **Priority:** P2
- **Story Points:** 5
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Create service to handle sorting logic
  - [ ] Implement sorting by time savings
  - [ ] Implement sorting by difficulty level
  - [ ] Implement sorting by implementation time
  - [ ] Support both ascending and descending order
  - [ ] Add unit tests for sorting logic

### Add Sort Preference Persistence
- **Story:** As a DevOps engineer, I want my sort preference to be saved so that it persists between sessions
- **Priority:** P2
- **Story Points:** 2
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Create database migration for sort preference
  - [ ] Add API endpoint to update sort preference
  - [ ] Store sort preference in user settings
  - [ ] Load saved sort preference on page load
  - [ ] Apply saved sort preference automatically

### Connect Sorting UI to Backend
- **Story:** As a DevOps engineer, I want the sorting controls to update the recommendation list so that I see results in my chosen order
- **Priority:** P2
- **Story Points:** 3
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Wire up sort dropdown to API calls
  - [ ] Show loading state while sorting
  - [ ] Update URL parameters with sort selection
  - [ ] Handle error cases gracefully
  - [ ] Update list view when sort changes


## Non-Functional Requirements
- Performance: API response times < 200ms
- Security: Follow OWASP Top 10 guidelines
- Scalability: Support horizontal scaling
